Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1261
Claimant:
Ashley Duncan
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
13 Aug 2023
Claim reported by the insured's representing attorney on the sideswipe that occurred while the claimant was changing
lanes. The attorney advised that the claimant sustained a concussion and requested that all communication be routed
through their office.
16 Aug 2023
Confirmed that the driver listed on the policy was the operator of the insured vehicle at the time of loss. Coverage was
in force on the date of the incident and no issues with the policy have been identified.
5 Sep 2023
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant's vehicle in the adjacent lane at the time of contact. Responding
officers documented the lane change and the side contact between the two vehicles.
10 Sep 2023
Statements from two independent witnesses match the claimant's account of the lane change and the contact that
followed. Scene photographs were also reviewed and are consistent with that sequence of events.
30 Sep 2023
Spoke with the other driver, whose account of the lane change and contact agrees with the claimant's version. No
dispute has been raised regarding how the collision happened.
20 Dec 2023
Inspected the insured vehicle and the damage to the rear quarter panel and mirror housing matches the described
impact. No prior damage to the vehicle has been found in the records or photographs reviewed.
20 Jan 2024
Reviewed the claimant's medical file, which lists a concussion diagnosed after the collision. The reported symptoms
are consistent with the type of injury expected from a crash of this kind.
6 Feb 2024
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this diagnosis, and the treating provider has
documented the ongoing course of care. No earlier injury to the same area of the head or neck appears in the
medical history provided.
27 Feb 2024
The claimant's representative provided a follow-up statement adding minor details about the seaitng position and the
moment of impact. The core account has remained the same across all statements given to date.
1 Apr 2024
Reviewed all information gathered to date. The claim is being handled on the basis of the consistent account, witenss
statements, physical evidence, and medical records, with the treatment timeline noted for ongoing review.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
